summary: The hospital says you owe $2,380 for an emergency room visit. You may be able to get this bill lowered or forgiven through financial assistance.

deadlines.what: Pay the bill or set up a payment plan
deadlines.sourceQuote: Payment in full or a payment arrangement is due by November 9, 2026.

steps: Check the bill for services you did not get.
Ask the hospital for a financial assistance (charity care) application.
Ask for an itemized bill that lists every charge.
If you cannot pay all at once, ask for a payment plan with no interest.
Do not put this bill on a credit card before you ask for help.
